★ Request
Display sprite: K.S. Miracle (Casual)

■ Stage Direction
1 second of silence at the start
Not out of fatigue or sighing, but feeling refreshed/pleasant.

Not at all.
I could hear the birds singing, and I had a very relaxing time.

K.S. Miracle lets out a relieved breath,
then turns her calm, gentle gaze toward me.

K.S. Miracle smiles warmly and peacefully.
...I feel somewhat awkward.

Looking at K.S. Miracle's face, she is smiling happily.
Falling asleep was definitely a blunder, but did she get a chance to relax?

Perhaps my daily fatigue has caught up with me, as my stamina drained
far faster than I expected. K.S. Miracle peers over at me with concern.

Eat as much as you can, and let's do our best with walking rehab.
Your dad and the rest of us will do our best with you. ...We'll be right by your side.

Huh, no, you can't! That's bad for your health, and...
if you were to collapse, Trainer, I...

(You're working so hard for my sake... and because of my condition,
you have to think about so much more than an ordinary trainer would.)
...You brought me out here today to let me rest, didn't you?

My gratitude toward you...
words alone could never be enough, but...

...Ah, I could hear you breathing in your sleep, too.
Did you have any nice dreams?

Hiding my trembling legs, I sit down on the bench.
I rest my elbows on the table in front of me and catch my breath.

Please... there's no need to apologize.
After walking this far, it's only natural to be tired.

...How about some cold water?
I was just getting thirsty myself, so I'll go buy some!
...Trainer...
Just standing is part of my training, after all.
(Because you always—speak to me in such a warm voice.)

There was a bird along the way that I'd never seen before.
Did you notice it? And a squirrel family, too!

I watch K.S. Miracle trot off toward the kiosk,
breathing a sigh of relief that we managed to arrive safely.

I'm sorry, but I noticed.
Because—

Please sleep for just a little longer.
Before the sun goes down... I'll be sure to wake you.

Wishing desperately for this to be a wonderful day for her,
I forced a smile and kept putting one foot in front of the other.

The whole point was for K.S. Miracle to take a breather.
It defeats the purpose if I end up holding her back.
(Everyone who worries about me has such kind eyes.)

Apparently, I had fallen completely asleep since then.
When she woke me up, I panicked for a moment, but...

(...Kind people get hurt easily. Because they try to take on
other people's pain, too. Even though... they don't have to.)
Is something the matter?

We sure walked a lot. ...Trainer, are you all right?
You're... out of breath, aren't you?

(You're so exhausted that you won't even wake up when called.
...Well, that makes sense. After all, you're always...)

—In truth, that wasn't the only reason.
Giving K.S. Miracle a chance to unwind was the main goal.

I need to work even harder so that K.S. Miracle feels comfortable
leaning on me and depending on me.

...Phew. The fresh air feels wonderful. If this counts as
stamina training, I'd love to do it regularly.

...Really? In that case, I'm glad.
Ahaha, you actually had me going for a second.

Let's rest here a bit and head back together.
If it's just this kind of stamina training, I could do it on my own—

...Feigning ignorance of your kindness just to put your mind
at ease... That's pretty absurd of me, isn't it?

......
Fufu. Sitting next to you, I can hear your breathing so clearly.

Under the pretext of boosting our stamina,
I brought K.S. Miracle out for a hike.

Ahaha, how many times does that make now?
I was the one who let you sleep, so please don't worry about it.

I let my body go limp and slump onto the table. Accumulated fatigue and
physical exhaustion hit me all at once, carrying my consciousness straight into dreams—
...Trainer?

Listen to me, K.S. Miracle. You don't have to give up on anything.
...It's okay. We are right here with you.

For that very reason, I can't stay down in the dumps forever.
I'll use today's failure as fuel...

No matter how agonizing it gets or how far she pushes herself,
she doesn't see it as a burden, but rather embraces it with pure joy.

Kei-chan! Were you reading a picture book? Oh, what a cute swan.
...I'm so glad, you seem to be feeling well today.

That's why... I can tell.
Just how much you're looking out for me.

...We walked quite a long way, after all.
Make sure you drink some water when you wake up, okay?

Phew. We finally made it.
...Trainer, let's sit on that bench over there and take a breather.

The train is pretty empty.
Trainer, please don't mind me and stay seated.
